summary: Resolved Chromium iframe sandbox escape security warning in live_canvas.js
details: Updated iframe sandbox attribute in live_canvas.js to 'allow-scripts allow-modals allow-forms allow-popups' (removing allow-same-origin) to strictly comply with W3C/Chromium security specs.

summary: Resolved iframe DOMException in live_canvas.js using HTML5 iframe.srcdoc property
details: Replaced contentWindow.document.write() with iframe.srcdoc = fullHtml in live_canvas.js, allowing sandboxed web app previews to render cleanly without cross-origin security exceptions.

summary: Implemented Web Audio API Synthesizer Sound Engine for real-time UI feedback
details: Created sound_effects.js providing zero-latency, high-frequency synthesized audio feedback for message send (playSend), completion (playDone), reminder chime (playChime), micro click (playClick), and error alerts (playError). Integrated across main.js and agent_stream.js.

summary: Fixed Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export' in agent_stream.js
details: Added missing closing brace to _updateDynamicHeaderTitle() function on line 176 of agent_stream.js which caused export function handleChatAgentEvent to be nested inside another function.

summary: Upgraded ReminderSkill v2.0.0 with real-time countdown timers, WebSocket broadcast, audio chime, and toast alerts
details: Added parse_delay_seconds helper and _schedule_timer countdown worker in ReminderSkill, broadcast_reminder_notification helper in app.py, and playReminderChime audio synth + reminder_trigger alert bubble in agent_stream.js.

summary: Replaced hardcoded fake email string in user profile menu header with dynamic user identity name
details: Removed static string 'anshu@gmail.com' from index.html and debate_page.js, and bound .user-menu-header to dynamically display configured user identity name (or 'User Account') loaded from Settings.

summary: Restored standard Lucide vector icons for Left Sidebar Action items per user request
details: Restored data-lucide='message-circle-plus', 'swords', 'compass', and 'image' on #btn-new-chat, #btn-nav-playground, #nav-skills-btn, and #btn-nav-images in index.html.

summary: Fixed ReferenceError: header is not defined in markdown.js enhanceTables()
details: Removed orphaned line 323 in markdown.js that called lucide.createIcons({ parent: header }) where header was undefined.

summary: Applied user-provided Microsoft Fluent System Image SVG path for #btn-nav-images with fill='currentColor'
details: Updated Images button SVG in index.html with exact user-provided Fluent Image vector path using fill='currentColor' for dynamic theme switching.

summary: Switched Left Sidebar Action icons to Microsoft Fluent System Icons (Regular Outline SVG)
details: Updated SVGs on #btn-new-chat, #btn-nav-playground, #nav-skills-btn, and #btn-nav-images in index.html to Microsoft Fluent System Icons Regular Outline variants (stroke-width 1.75, rounded caps and joins) with dynamic stroke: currentColor rule in 3_sidebar_nav.css.

summary: Integrated official Microsoft Fluent System Icons (Rounded Filled SVG) for Left Sidebar Action items
details: Replaced Lucide vector icons on #btn-new-chat, #btn-nav-playground, #nav-skills-btn, and #btn-nav-images in index.html with Microsoft Fluent System Icons rounded filled SVG vector paths and added .fluent-icon fill: currentColor rules in 3_sidebar_nav.css.

summary: Reverted sidebar and settings icons back to original clean Lucide vector icons per user request
details: Restored <i data-lucide='...'> for New Chat, Skills, Images, and Settings Modal Skills items in index.html.

summary: Integrated custom PNG icons (message.png, skills.png) for New Chat and Skills navigation buttons
details: Copied message.png and skills.png into static assets/icons/, updated #btn-new-chat, #nav-skills-btn, and Settings Modal Skills nav item in index.html with automatic light/dark theme inverting via .custom-nav-icon.

summary: Integrated custom PNG image icon for Left Sidebar Images button with dynamic light/dark theme inverting
details: Copied image-.png-color-black.png into static assets/icons/image-black.png, added .custom-nav-icon with body.dark/oled filter: invert(1) rule in 3_sidebar_nav.css, and updated #btn-nav-images in index.html.

summary: Removed all blue and generic color highlights in favor of strict neutral monochrome palette
details: Changed active settings nav icon color from blue to var(--text-primary) in 1_settings_base.css, and changed :focus-visible ring outline from var(--blue) to neutral var(--text-2) in base.css.

summary: Removed stray closing brace in 1_settings_base.css that broke .modal-nav-item width parsing
details: Removed extra unmatched closing brace above .modal-nav-item line 70. Enforced width: 100% !important and display: flex !important so all settings nav items stretch fully across the sidebar width.

summary: Enforced Rule #3 (Zero Borders/Outlines) and Rule #5 (Active Pill Highlight) on Settings Modal
details: Added global button border reset in base.css, removed browser default button borders on .modal-nav-item in 1_settings_base.css, set modal-nav background tint to var(--input-bg), and set active item to clean borderless pure white pill (#FFFFFF).

summary: Fixed HTTP 500 OperationalError on /api/chats and /api/chats/sync
details: Added _ensure_tables() helper in EpisodicStore to auto-create missing chat_sessions and chat_messages SQLite tables on database query execution.

summary: Implemented complete remediation for pre-production audit report findings
details: Added sanitizeHtml() XSS guard for AI markdown outputs in agent_stream.js and messages.js. Added WS error forwarding, attachment filename sanitization, 300s timeout guard, and unique voice temp filenames in app.py. Fixed --font-mono to real monospace font stack, added :focus-visible keyboard navigation styles, and removed duplicate CSS vars in base.css. Implemented DocumentFragment batching in session.js for zero reflows. Added user-facing offline toast notification in socket_manager.js.

summary: Scroll-to-bottom arrow now only shows on active chat page, not on home/welcome screen
details: Added home-screen visibility check in chat_minimap.js updateScrollTracking(). Arrow button only shows when #home-screen has class 'hidden' (i.e., user is in an active conversation).

summary: Removed Documents section from Library and removed background card box from Media empty state
details: Removed Documents section accordion from images_page.js, and set background: transparent !important and border: none !important on .img-gallery-empty in 8c_image_gallery.css.

summary: Fixed Library empty state cards (Documents & Media) visibility in Light Mode
details: Updated .library-empty-box and .img-gallery-empty in 8c_image_gallery.css by setting background: var(--hover) and border: 1px solid var(--border), ensuring soft grey card container contrast against white background in Light mode.

summary: Added 1px border outline to permission request card and enabled soft line wrapping with height-synced line numbers in Live Canvas
details: Updated permission-request-card in agent_stream.js with border: 1px solid var(--border) and box-shadow. Updated Live Canvas code editor in live_canvas.js and 9_live_canvas.css to set wrap='soft', white-space: pre-wrap, overflow-x: hidden (eliminating horizontal scrollbars), and implemented a hidden DOM mirror height calculation in updateLineNumbers() so line numbers stay 100% synchronized with wrapped lines.
